title: Location restrictions.
officialText:
Marquee signs erected on marquees projecting beyond the street line shall be limited to those
occupancy groups and locations provided by Section 3202.2.1.4.5 of this code.
SECTION BC H114
FLEXIBLE FABRIC SIGNS
